text.description_html:
Pemko Automatic Door Bottom Seal

Mortise type automatic door bottom seal kit. Smoother action positive seal mechanism. All Pemko automatic door bottoms consist of an aluminum case which surrounds a movable drop-bar seal. The drop-bar seal is actuated by a plunger which contacts the jamb as the door is closing, forcing the drop-bar seal down against the floor / threshold.

The sponge neoprene insert conforms well to irregular surfaces such as carpet, stone and grout lines. Seal up to a 3/4" gap under the door.

Field sizable 2" (you can only shorten it a total of 2 inches). Powder coated non-rusting aluminum blade housing. Packaged with installation screws.

Specifications for Pemko 411ARL Automatic Door Bottom Seal

  • Total Length: 36"
  • Total Height: 1-3/8"
  • Max Door Gap to Floor: 3/4"
  • Seal Color: Black
  • Handed, Reversible
  • Finish: Aluminum

Please allow 15-30 days to ship. Made to order in any size ranging from 18" to 72". Please Contact Us with your requirements.

***Not Returnable***

Sold Individually
